business_summary: Aica Kogyo Company, Limited manufactures and sells chemical products in Japan, China, rest of Asia, Oceania, and internationally. It operates through Chemical Products and Building Materials segments. The company offers decorative panels comprising high pressure laminates, decorative boards, and architectural films; fire retardant decorative panels; counters; housing and public products, including doors, sliding doors, storage units, and toilet booths; industrial and architectural adhesives, and industrial and composite board resins; construction resins, including wall and floor coating materials, repair and reinforcing materials, and corrosive preventive materials; and specially and performance materials, such as hot melts, UV-curable and water based resins, and polymer beads. It also provides exterior and interior finishing coating materials, floor coating materials, various adhesives, organic particles, etc; and melamine laminate, decorative plywood, interior doors, interior building materials, countertops, storage doors, non-combustible decorative materials, extruded cement boards, etc. The company offers chemical products for use in non-construction fields, such as automobiles, daily necessities, and electronic materials; and laminates and building materials for use in commercial, office, educational and cultural, transport, health care and welfare, accommodation, warehouse and factory, and housing facilities. Additionally, the company manufactures and sells laminates and allied products. The company was formerly known as Aichi Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Aica Kogyo Company, Limited in June 1966. Aica Kogyo Company, Limited was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Kiyosu, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Aica Kogyo Company, Limited는 일본, 중국, 기타 아시아 지역, 오세아니아 및 국제적으로 화학 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 화학 제품 및 건축 자재 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 고압 라미네이트, 장식 보드 및 건축용 필름으로 구성된 장식 패널을 제공합니다. 난연성 장식 패널; 카운터; 문, 미닫이 문, 보관 장치 및 화장실 부스를 포함한 주택 및 공공 제품; 산업용 및 건축용 접착제, 산업용 및 복합 보드 수지; 벽 및 바닥 코팅재, 수리 및 보강재, 부식 방지재를 포함한 건축용 수지; 핫멜트, UV 경화성 및 수성 수지, 폴리머 비드 등의 특수 기능성 소재 등이 있습니다. 또한 내외장 마감재 코팅재, 바닥 코팅재, 각종 접착제, 유기입자 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 및 멜라민 라미네이트, 장식 합판, 인테리어 도어, 건축 내장재, 조리대, 수납 도어, 불연성 장식재, 압출 시멘트 보드 등 자동차 등 비건축 분야에 사용되는 화학 제품을 제공하는 회사입니다.
